profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Skilled software engineer with demonstrated proficiency in iOS mobile application development, leading teams, and mentoring engineers. I've built successful user-facing applications on both the supply and demand sides of a marketplace, serving several million customers monthly and multiple engineering teams simultaneously.

I'm an engaged engineer with a people-first mentality, keeping customers (both internal and external) at the heart of everything I do. I'm a thorough and intentional developer of mobile experiences who is always aiming to better understand and address the root causes of problems.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Lead a team of exceptional native mobile engineers to deliver Hover's exterior capture functionality in the form of a native SDK to Fortune 500 clients
- Partnered with leadership and ICs across product and engineering to define technical golden path and roadmap to deliver new mobile product.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Given increased quality concerns, drove multi-year initiative to rearchitect Eventbrite consumer app using TCA and SwiftUI. This improved team autonomy, lowered time spent triaging issues, and improved test coverage to 85%.
- Improved delivery cadence of the Eventbrite consumer app by 3x and fully automated the release process.
- Facilitated the transition from a centralized mobile team to 6+ teams distributed by domain in pursuit of executing on a mobile-driven company-wide product strategy.
- Acted as a trusted cross-functional resource, advisor and mentor. Guided teams and individuals through technology transitions and product development.
- Defined and executed on an improved testing vision for mobile, resulting in 1000+ fast-running unit & snapshot tests across the entire product.
positions.insights: Software Architectural Design, iOS Development and +3 skills

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- SME for the Eventbrite Organizer app
- Lead iOS team to reimagine the feature set for the Organizer app for a post-pandemic user base
- Implemented documentation process to facilitate asynchronous communication and enable long-term information retention among an international team.
- Architected framework to enable shared authentication between Eventbrite's apps. The architecture was later used to power Eventbrite's "Architecture 2.0" for the Eventbrite consumer app.
- Migrated all internal/external dependencies from Carthage to Swift Package Manager, simplifying the developer experience.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
- Implemented creator-facing tools to improve Eventbrite's position in the mobile ticketing space.
- Lead effort to migrate 150+ manual test flows to daily recurring automated UI tests.
- Lead engineering initiative to integrate new payment terminal, allowing creators to self-manage contactless payments at-the-door during the pandemic.
- Traveled to music venues nationwide to participate in customer interviews and requirements gathering for new features.

positions.title: Senior iOS Developer
positions.description: Served as technical lead and engineer point-of-contact for contracts. Built shared frameworks used to bootstrap new contracts.

positions.title: iOS Developer
positions.description: Worked on a small team of software engineers contracted to build & expand iOS and Android apps for a leading lawn care service provider that offers tailored solutions for maintaining and enhancing the health and appearance of residential and commercial landscapes.

projects.title: Syllabus
projects.description:
Syllabus is an iOS app with the intention of showing your assignments, due dates, and weights. Also calculates your maximum, minimum, and projected grades for a given class, as well as calculates semester and cumulative GPA given these statistics. Planned features include class schedule reminders as well as opt-in location-based attendance tracking.

Created as a learning project to explore the unidirectional data flow techniques, practice professional git management methods, effectively leverage unit testing and code coverage, conform to a style guide, utilize/understand CODEBEAT programming guidelines.

projects.title: Available
projects.description: With better event planning in mind, Available acts as a middle-man when it comes to scheduling events between two or more people. Gathering data from your approved calendars, Available creates a semi-public availablity domain that allows your friends to see when you're open to meet. With Smart Compare, Available makes it easy to overlay your availability with multiple users to determine mutually-available times.

organizations.name: CocoaHeads Nashville
organizations.description:
CocoaHeads is an international meetup of iOS & macOS developers used to learn and network among others.

I co-organize the monthly meetup of 10-20 regular members, coordinating guest speakers, working with venues, driving participant engagement through Slack, and building the community of Apple-related developers in the Greater Nashville area.
